text:
Alex: heads up — found an AWS access key in an internal log pulled from s3-archive. object was public for ~2h.
Maria: can you paste the key id? which service account is that tied to?
Alex: KeyId: AKIA...T5Q (truncated). It looks attached to service principal `redwood-logshipper-prod` used by the archive job. The log line shows Vault export + KMS decrypt call before the upload.
Kevin: if it's a Vault export, maybe someone ran a debug dump? Any clue which Vault token was used?
Alex: The log has an env var `VAULT_TOKEN=...` but token was truncated. Timestamp 2026-03-19T22:13Z. The S3 object metadata shows uploader was an EC2 instance with role `archive-agent-role`.
sec-oncall: elevating to incident: cred-leak-1806-1. See incident doc link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/cred-leak-1806
Sam: immediate actions: 1) revoke any long-lived creds tied to that key 2) rotate KMS wrapping key if used 3) rotate Vault root/replication tokens if necessary 4) audit CloudTrail+Vault audit logs to scope usage
Ashley: agree. I'd also suggest adding a secondary secret to Vault and do a staged switch — avoid mass outage. Owner for rotate keys?
Maria: I'll take rotation of the AWS access key and update IAM. Kevin, can you check whether the KMS key used to wrap the exported blob is customer-managed? If so, rotate/disable and rewrap.
Kevin: KMS key id: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. It's customer-managed. Rotation is enabled but we need to schedule rewrap for the exported blob because Vault auto-wrapped values may still be decryptable with old key if someone retrieved ciphertext.
Alex: plan proposal (short):
- Step 0: Freeze writes from archive job (disable cron) — @deploy-bot please pause `archive-job-prod`.
- Step 1: Revoke AWS access key + mark compromised IAM principal as disabled.
- Step 2: Create replacement IAM role with short-lived STS assumption (no static creds) and update agent to use role.
- Step 3: Pull Vault export artifact, rewrap secrets with new KMS key, store back to Vault (create new versioned secrets).
- Step 4: Roll config: add new secret as secondary, flip apps to read new secret, monitor for errors, then remove old secret.
- Step 5: Run forensics: CloudTrail, Vault audit devices (enable if missing), and S3 access logs.
- Step 6: Postmortem + policy updates (no plain Vault export to S3, remove debug logging of env vars)
Maria: I'll own Step 1 and 4. Kevin owns Step 3 and KMS ops. Alex will help with forensic logs. Ashley will own Step 6 and the RBAC policy changes.
deploy-bot: pausing schedule `archive-job-prod`... done (job id: aj-prod-1987).
vault-bot: Vault audit-log device status: enabled on primary: true, last_rotate: 2025-12-10. Recommend enabling sys/audit for replication nodes.
Maria: commands I'm running now:
```
# revoke access key
aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIA...T5Q --status Inactive --user-name archive-agent
aws iam delete-access-key --access-key-id AKIA...T5Q --user-name archive-agent
# create new role + trust
aws iam create-role --role-name archive-agent-sts --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
```
Kevin: for rewrapping:
```
# decrypt blob with old key (done in secure env), re-encrypt with new key
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.enc --key-id old-key-arn --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > blob
aws kms encrypt --key-id new-key-arn --plaintext fileb://blob --output text --query CiphertextBlob > reblob.enc
# update secret in Vault
vault write secret/data/archive export=@reblob.enc
```
sec-oncall: quick checklist for audit:
- CloudTrail insights: collect events between 2026-03-19T20:00Z and 2026-03-19T23:00Z
- S3 server access logs for bucket `s3-archive-prod`
- Vault audit logs for token usage, IP origins
- Check other artifacts in the same S3 prefix for exposures
Sam: small RBAC follow-ups: limit `archive-agent-role` to `kms:Decrypt` only for specific key alias, and require session-tags for requestor service name. Also move to short-lived creds only.
Ashley: policy changes draft in PR: https://github.internal/redwood/security/pulls/403 — adds deny for env var dump in `archive-job` containers and audits KMS-access.
Maria: timeline: rotate creds now (15m), rewrap + reconfigure (2h), canary flip (30m), full cutover (1h), postmortem writeup (EOD).
Alex: noted. I'll start evidence collection and save hashes of the leaked object. Thanks all — will update thread with progress.
Sam: TL;DR: leaked AWS key from public S3 object -> revoke -> replace with role+STS -> rewrap Vault exports -> enable tighter audit + RBAC.
Maria: done: access key revoked, new role created, updated archive job to assume role. proceeding with rewrap.
Kevin: rewrap finished, uploaded new secret version to Vault, creating canary deployment for archive-consumers.
Alex: canary looks good, no runtime errors. proceeding to full cutover in 10m.
Ashley: opening postmortem doc now.
sec-oncall: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close when postmortem ready.
Alex: closing here once postmortem link posted.
